name: Human intercostal skeletal muscle aging atlas (scRNA-seq and snRNA-seq, young vs aged)
description: A total of 43 coarse and 82 fine-grained skeletal muscle cell type clusters were identified from the joint single-cell (90,902 cells) and single-nuclei (92,259 cells) skeletal muscle atlas from 17 deceased transplant organ donors (8 young, ~20-40 y; 9 aged, ~60-75 y). Cells and nuclei were first integrated separately with scVI using 10X run as a batch and donors and 10x Genomics Chromium chemistries (v2, v3 or v2/v3) as categorical covariates. They underwent iterative leiden clustering and were initially annotated using cannonical markers in the field and later in-house generated celltypist model trained on the earlier version of the dataset.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: Displayed cell annotations represent 43 coarse cell type clusters derived using combined manual and automatic annotation using CellTypist.

labels.name: VenEC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (ACKR1, PLVAP, CCL14) defining two subsets: VenEC and additional VenEC-CCL2+ which is high in CCL2, ICAM1, SELE, RND1. We noticed ACKR1, SELE, POSTN running differential expression. Venous endothelium.

labels.name: ArtEC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (HEY1, GJA5, CLU, SEMA3G). We noticed SLC9A3R2, IFI27, ICAM2 running differential expression. Arterial blood vessel endothelium.

labels.name: LymphEC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field LYVE1, PROX1 as well as a subset with CD8A expression. Lymphatic vessel endothelium.

labels.name: CapEC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (CA4, RGCC, FABP4). We noticed GPIHBP1, CLDN5, FABP4 running differential expression. Capillary microvasculature endothelium.

labels.name: SMC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (MYH11, ACTA2, TAGLN) with several subsets: RAMP1+,  CCL2+ and pericyte intermediate. We noticed MYH11, RERGL, ACTG2 running differential expression. Vascular smooth muscle cell.

labels.name: Pericyte
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (RGS5, APOD, ABCC9, STEAP4) with one subset expressing CCL26. We noticed RGS5, NDUFA4L2, HIGD1B running differential expression. Mural pericapillary cell.

labels.name: FB
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field for fibroblasts (PDGFRA and DCN) and specific subsets including adventitial: FBN1, PRG4, PCOLCE2, CD70 and parenchymal fibroblasts:COL4A1, COL15A1, ALDH1A2. We noticed DCN, CFD, APOD running differential expression.

labels.name: EnFB
labels.rationale: Endoneurial fibroblasts populate the innermost connective tissue layer surrounding individual peripheral nerve fibres within a fascicle. Two CDH19+ and TAC1+ sub-states are resolved to differential expression markers: APOD, ANGPTL7, CDH19. Endoneurium fibroblast (peripheral nerve).
labels.ontologyAssessment: No CL term for endoneurial fibroblasts; CL:0000057 (fibroblast) is too generic and CL:0011027 (skeletal muscle fibroblast) misclassifies these as muscle-stromal rather than nerve-sheath cells. Two CDH19+ and TAC1+ sub-states are resolved in Kedlian 2024 with ANGPTL7, OSR2 and CDH19 being main markers. Anatomical context UBERON:0005844 endoneurium; synonyms endoneurium fibroblast, nerve endoneurial fibroblast. Supporting dois: 10.1038/s41588-022-01243-4, 10.3389/fncel.2021.624826.

labels.name: PnFB
labels.rationale: Perineurial fibroblasts form the sleeve cells around each nerve fascicle and contribute to the blood-nerve barrier. Distinct from perimysial fibroblasts of muscle. Dotplot markers: NGFR, SLC22A3, KRT19,  ITGA6, SLC2A1, FGL2 . Top differentially expressed genes: CLDN1, KRT19, SLC2A1. Perineurium fibroblast (blood-nerve barrier).
labels.ontologyAssessment: No CL term for perineurial fibroblasts — the sleeve cells around the nerve fascicle forming the blood-nerve barrier; not to be confused with perimysial fibroblasts of muscle. Resolved in Kedlian 2024 by NGFR, SLC2A3, ITGA6, KRT19. Closest parent CL:0000057 fibroblast; anatomical context UBERON:0000380 perineurium; synonyms perineurium fibroblast, nerve perineurial fibroblast. Supporting DOIs: 10.1038/s41588-022-01243-4, 10.3389/fncel.2021.624826.

labels.name: Tenocyte
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (TNMD, MKX, FMOD, COL11A1, SCX). We noticed TNMD, COMP, MKX running differential expression. Tendon-resident fibroblast.

labels.name: nmSchwann
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (NRN1, SORBS2, CDH2, L1CAM). We noticed COL20A1, CDH19, S100B running differential expression. Non-myelinating Schwann (Remak) cell.

labels.name: mSchwann
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (MLIP, MPZ, MBP, PLP1). We noticed MPZ, CLDN19, MT3 running differential expression. Myelinating peripheral nerve glia.

labels.name: CD4+T
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CD3D, IL7R, SELL, CCR7; we noticed IL7R, CD3D, CD3G running differential expression. Helper / regulatory T cell.

labels.name: CD16+NK
labels.fullName: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include FCGR3A, GZMB, FGFBP2, GNLY, PRF1, NKG7; we noticed GNLY, NKG7, KLRF1 running differential expression. Cytotoxic NK (CD56-dim).

labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include NKG7, XCL1, XCL2, KLRC1; we noticed GNLY, NKG7, KLRF1 running differential expression. Cytokine-producing NK (CD56-bright).

labels.name: CD8+T
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CD8B, CD8A, CD3D, CRTAM; we noticed IL7R, CD3D, CD3G running differential expression. Cytotoxic T lymphocyte.

labels.name: B-plasma
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include MZB1, JCHAIN; we noticed JCHAIN, IGHG2, IGHG1 running differential expression. Antibody-secreting terminal B cell.

labels.name: B-cell
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CD79A, TCL1A, MS4A1; we noticed CD79A, MS4A1, IGHM running differential expression. Antibody-producing mature B lymphocyte.

labels.name: cDC1
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CLEC9A, XCR1, IRF8, IDO1; we noticed CLEC9A, LGALS2, HLA-DRA running differential expression. Cross-presenting myeloid dendritic cell.

labels.name: cDC2
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CD1C, CLEC10A, FCER1A; we noticed FCER1A, HLA-DRA, LYZ running differential expression. Antigen-presenting myeloid dendritic cell.

labels.name: Macrophage
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197) pan-macrophage markers: CD163, C1QC and subtype markers for LYVE1 (LYVE1, F13A1), HLAIIhi (APOE, APOC1, FABP5) and Lipid-associated macrophages (SPP1, TREM2).

labels.name: CD16+Mono
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include FCGR3A, CDKN1C, CX3CR1, LST1, AIF1; we noticed EREG, FCN1, LYZ running differential expression. Non-classical patrolling monocyte.

labels.name: CD14+Mono
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include CD14, S100A12, S100A8, S100A9, VCAN, FCN1; we noticed EREG, FCN1, LYZ running differential expression. Classical monocyte.

labels.name: Mast
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include MS4A2, TPSAB1, TPSB2, CPA3, KIT; we noticed TPSB2, TPSAB1, CPA3 running differential expression. Tissue mast cell.

labels.name: Neutrophil
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field corresponding to different stages of neutrophil differentiation from pro (AZU1, MPO, ELANE), pre (LTF, LCN2, CAMP) and mature neutrophils (FCGR3B, CSF3R).Polymorphonuclear granulocyte.

labels.name: Eosinophil
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (PRG2, EPX, CLC, HDC). We noticed CLC, PRG3, PRG2 running differential expression. Granulocyte (parasitic / allergic immunity).

labels.name: pDC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated with CellTypist using the Immune_All_Low model trained on the cross-tissue immune cell atlas (DOI: 10.1126/science.abl5197). Canonical markers in the field include LILRA4, CLEC4C, IRF7, IL3RA; we noticed LILRA4, PLD4, IRF4 running differential expression. Type-I IFN-producing dendritic cell.

labels.name: Mesothelium
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (MSLN, ITLN1). We noticed ITLN1, MSLN, HP running differential expression. These cells likely respresent pleural cavity-lining cells.

labels.name: MF-Isc(fg)
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated using slow-twitch myofiber markers (MYH7, TNNT1) with abundant cytoplasmic transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C) showing increased expression compared to fast-twitch nuclei as well as ratio of spliced transcripts (~97%) which indicates this cell likely respresents a myofiber fragment captured in scRNA-seq libraries due to incomplete dissociation.
labels.ontologyAssessment: Not a distinct cell type — technical artefact: type I (slow-twitch) myofiber sarcoplasmic fragments captured in scRNA-seq libraries. Should NOT receive its own CL term; reusing CL:0000189 (slow muscle cell) is appropriate. Enriched slow-type markers (TNNT1, MYH7) as well as abundant cytoplasmic myofiber transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C).

labels.name: MF-IIsc(fg)
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated using fast-twitch myofiber markers (MYH1, MYH2, TNNT3) with abundant cytoplasmic transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C) showing increased expression compared to fast-twitch nuclei as well as ratio of spliced transcripts (~97%) which indicates this cell likely respresents a myofiber fragment captured in scRNA-seq libraries due to incomplete dissociation.
labels.ontologyAssessment: Not a distinct cell type — technical artefact: type II (fast-twitch) myofiber sarcoplasmic fragments captured in scRNA-seq libraries. Should NOT receive its own CL term; reusing CL:0000190 (fast muscle cell) is appropriate. Enriched fast-type markers (TNNT3, MYH1, MYH2) as well as abundant cytoplasmic myofiber transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C).

labels.name: MF_type-MYH8+
labels.ontologyTerm: fetal and neonatal skeletal muscle fiber
labels.rationale: MYH8+ myocytes were defined based on co-expression of embryonic myosins MYH8, MYOG, fast-twitch myofiber markers TNNT1, MYH1, MYH2 as well as additional markers: CDKN1A, ADIRF and  SAA1
labels.ontologyAssessment: Closest existing CL term is CL:0009098 (fetal and neonatal skeletal muscle fiber), but it does not capture the aged-muscle regenerative MYH8+ state observed here. Both share MYH8 and MYOG (embryonic markers) on a fast-twitch sarcomeric program (TNNC2, TNNI2, MYL1, TNNT3, MYLPF), reflecting the canonical developmental → regenerative re-use of embryonic myosins. CL:0009098, however, is defined for fetal/neonatal developmental context, whereas in Kedlian 2024 MYH8+ cells are an intermediate state between MuSCs and fast-twitch myofibers in aged donors, and equivalent MYH3/MYH8 reactivation is reported in adult DMD (Webster 1988). A new CL term for the adult regenerative MYH8+ myocyte — sibling of CL:0009098 — is justified. Closest parent CL:0008002 skeletal muscle fiber; alternative CL:0008046 extrafusal muscle fiber; synonyms MYH8+ myocyte, regenerative myofiber, embryonic-myosin+ adult myocyte. Supporting DOIs: 10.1186/s13395-015-0046-6; 10.1016/0092-8674(88)90463-1

labels.name: MF_type-RASA4+
labels.rationale: RASA4+ myocyte  was defined based on differential expression analysis with RASA4, FLCN and FNIP1 as major markers together with fast-type myofiber markers (TNNT3, MYH1, MYH2).
labels.ontologyAssessment: RASA4+ myocyte is a potential new state defined by FLCN, FNIP1, RASA4 together with fast-twitch markers. No validation or prior confirmation available. Closest parent CL:0000190 fast muscle cell; sibling of MF-II; synonyms RASA4+ myofiber, RASA4+ specialised fast-type myocyte. Supporting DOI: 10.1038/s43587-024-00613-3.

labels.name: MuSC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (PAX7, MYF5, SPRY1) for satellite cells. We noticed 3 additional smaller subsets of satellite cells by performing clustering and differential expression analysis within this cell type. These included TNFRSF12A+ subset with differential expression of TNFRSF12A, NOP16, NPTX2, FNDC4, MT1A genes, ICAM1+ subset with ICAM1, CXCL1, CXCL2, TNFAIP3, NFKBIZ, IRF1, IER3 and MYOG+ subset with MYOG, TNNI1, TNNT2, CKB, ACTC1, CLDN5 and MYOD1 expression.

labels.name: RBC
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (HBA1). We noticed AHSP, HBB, HBD running differential expression. Erythrocyte (blood contamination).

labels.name: Hyb
labels.fullName: Hybrid myofiber (type IIA/IIX or type I/IIA intermediate)
labels.rationale: These nuclei were annotated based on expression of general myofiber markers (CKM, MB) togethet with canonical fast-twitch: TNNT3, MYH1, MYH7 and slow-twitch myofiber markers:TNNT1, MYH7.
labels.ontologyAssessment: No CL term for hybrid myofibers co-expressing slow and fast myosin isoforms; CL:0000189 and CL:0000190 describe pure types only. Co-expression of MYH7+MYH2+ (I/IIA hybrid) or MYH2+MYH1+ (IIA/IIX hybrid) validated at protein and RNA level in Kedlian 2024; previously documented in Murgia 2017 single-fiber proteomics. Hybrid myofibers expand with age. Closest parents CL:0008002 skeletal muscle fiber and CL:0008046 extrafusal muscle fiber; sibling of CL:0000189 and CL:0000190; synonyms hybrid fiber, type IIA/IIX hybrid, type I/IIA hybrid, MYH7+MYH2+ myofiber. Supporting DOIs: 10.1016/j.celrep.2017.05.054.

labels.name: MF-I
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical slow-twitch myofiber markers in the field (MYH7, TNNT1, MB).

labels.name: MF-II
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical fast-twitch myofiber markers in the field (MYH2, MYH1, TNNT3, CKM).

labels.name: MTJ
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (NCAM1, MAML2, SNX7). We noticed AC020637.1, LINC02388, NCAM1 running differential expression. Muscle-tendon junction myonucleus.

labels.name: NMJ_accessory
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on the expression of myofiber markers together with the following novel markers coming up in differential expression analysis: SORBS2, EFNA5, GRIA2, STYK1 which were enriched in ‘synapse organization’ and ‘axon development’ terms but differed from other specialised myonuclei populations NMJ and MTJ. NMJ-adjacent novel myonucleus.
labels.ontologyAssessment: Newly described population in Kedlian 2024 — not previously documented in CL or the literature. Co-localises with NMJ subsynaptic myonuclei at the postsynaptic endplate but is transcriptionally distinct, so CL:4052025 (NMJ nucleus) is the closest related term but does NOT capture this population. Markers GRIA2 (AMPA-receptor), EFNA5 (axon-guidance), SORBS2 (AChR cluster organiser), BDNF, BMPR1B and several lncRNAs. Distinct TF regulons (ONECUT2, PGR) vs NMJ (ETV4, ETV5, SOX11). siRNA-knockdown of EFNA5 or SORBS2 reduces AChR clusters; EFNA5 overexpression promotes clustering (Kedlian 2024 Fig 3m,n). Expands with age, consistent with denervation/re-innervation. Sibling of CL:4052025 rather than direct parent; higher parent CL:0008046 extrafusal muscle fiber; synonyms NMJ-acc, NMJ accessory nuclei, NMJ-accessory myonucleus. Supporting DOIs: 10.1038/s43587-024-00613-3; 10.1016/j.cell.2011.12.028; 10.1128/MCB.00412-15; 10.1146/annurev-physiol-022516-034255.

labels.name: Adipocyte
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (PLIN1, ADIPOQ). We noticed ADIPOQ, PLIN1, SLC19A3 running differential expression. Fat-storing cells in muscle.

labels.name: MF-Isn(fg)
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated using slow-twitch myofiber markers (MYH7, TNNT1) with abundant cytoplasmic transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C) showing increased expression compared to fast-twitch nuclei as well as ratio of spliced transcripts (~97%) which indicates this cell likely respresents a myofiber fragment captured in snRNA-seq libraries due to incomplete dissociation.
labels.ontologyAssessment: Not a distinct cell type — technical artefact: type I (slow-twitch) myofiber sarcoplasmic fragments captured in snRNA-seq libraries. Should NOT receive its own CL term; reusing CL:0000189 (slow muscle cell) is appropriate. Enriched slow-type markers (TNNT1, MYH7) as well as abundant cytoplasmic myofiber transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C).

labels.name: MF-IIsn(fg)
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated using fast-twitch myofiber markers (MYH1, MYH2, TNNT3) with abundant cytoplasmic transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C) showing increased expression compared to fast-twitch nuclei as well as ratio of spliced transcripts (~97%) which indicates this cell likely respresents a myofiber fragment captured in snRNA-seq libraries due to incomplete dissociation.
labels.ontologyAssessment: Not a distinct cell type — technical artefact: type II (fast-twitch) myofiber sarcoplasmic fragments captured in scRNA-seq libraries. Should NOT receive its own CL term; reusing CL:0000190 (fast muscle cell) is appropriate. Enriched fast-type markers (TNNT3, MYH1, MYH2) as well as abundant cytoplasmic myofiber transcripts (CKM, MB and COX6C).

labels.name: NMJ
labels.rationale: This cell was annotated manually using canonical markers in the field (CHRNE, MUSK, ACHE, PLCB4). We noticed VMO1, AC104126.1, FGF6 running differential expression. Neuromuscular junction subsynaptic myonucleus.
